title: Types and conversions
description:
Complete the static methods in `Solution`:

```java
static double toCelsius(double fahrenheit)       // (F - 32) * 5 / 9
static double average(int a, int b, int c)       // the exact average: average(1, 2, 2) is 1.666...
static int parseOrDefault(String text, int fallback)   // the whole number in text (spaces around allowed), or fallback
static long toCents(double euros)                // euros as whole cents, rounded: 19.99 gives 1999, 0.29 gives 29
```
hints: `(a + b + c) / 3` divides two `int`s, which throws away the fraction. Divide by `3.0` instead.
`(long) (0.29 * 100)` is 28, because `0.29 * 100` is `28.999999999999996`. `Math.round` rounds to the nearest whole number instead of cutting off.
